description: This file contains unit tests for the tenantClient utility functions, testing functions like normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, setActiveTenant, and checking their behavior and interactions with mock fetch and localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID representations to a string identifier or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant data from server session endpoint, returning an array of tenant objects.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and communicates with the server.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in local storage, replacing any legacy key.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from local storage.
